assessment.coherence: Canonical request validation, pure conversion, shared shipped browser renderer and optional Node host remain one design. Cleanup now has one owned-process exit verdict and deadline, including cancelled startup and late ownership. Diagnostic and scheduling changes address native qualification without changing paint semantics.
assessment.specFidelity: Production qualification now exercises all original 50 SVGs through both shipped browser and Node adapters in three engines, alongside original conversion/viewport acceptance. Hidden and zero-opacity controls refuse positive paint. Font distribution, full import commands/UI, packs and remaining user-facing requirements remain explicit unfinished rows. No silent scope removal found.
assessment.standardsDrift: Public host API has ADR-0189, API report, changeset, bounded input tests and shipped notices. ADR-0191 records the larger provisioning envelope while retaining the 900-second verification and cold limits. Windows scheduling preserves projects, test inventory, assertions and zero retries. Failed and interrupted evidence is retained, and denied job API access is not retried through another route.
assessment.gateHonesty: Actual terminal exact-HEAD gate exits 1 at 31/71. Full verification, portable persistence, artwork/loader and the sanitizer/converter plus production three-engine SVG corpus leg pass. Missing features, trace, mutation evidence, licenses, layout changeset, documentation, final review and roadmap remain red. Remote qualification fails in the explicitly no-network environment and stale perf provenance is independently rejected; this does not authorize another network attempt. Focused harness tests reject absent/skipped/failed acceptance reports. No milestone-completion claim is supported.
assessment.architecture: Pure packages remain free of host effects. The optional Playwright peer and browser artifact live in CLI, with lazy import and explicit public entry. Browser creation uses owned loopback transport, request blocking before page creation, CSP, structured data and canonical receipts. Windows termination targets the captured owned process tree; helper completion alone cannot stand in for browser exit. Public API growth is deliberate and documented.
assessment.planHealth: 91/43 = 2.12x, exceeding the 1.5x trigger. Header now matches actual rows. Growth since cp7 is six added recovery rows; the eight reviewed commits also deliver already-planned M18.85 and M18.80. Later estimates should separately budget native process lifecycle, installed host packaging, cross-engine/OS qualification, CI diagnostics and inherited mutation recovery. Intermediate adapter completion must not stand in for import UX or font portability.
